0022600126.text: The Utah Jazz (1-2, 11th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 5th in the West) in Utah's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Jazz coming off a loss and sitting 2 games back in the Northwest while Memphis, 2nd in the Southwest, has won its first two games and is on a two-game winning streak. Utah is 1-1 at home and Memphis is 1-0 on the road, and the teams last met on October 21 in Memphis, where the Grizzlies won 123-103; the series stands at 2-2 for 2025-26 and Memphis leads 1-0 so far in 2026-27. Out for Utah are Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Memphis is without Karim Lopez (knee bruise) and Zach Edey (ankle).
